title: Chapter 36
text_arabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ غَيَّرَ دِينَهُ فَاضْرِبُوا عُنُقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمَعْنَى قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا نُرَى - وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ - ‏"‏ مَنْ غَيَّرَ دِينَهُ فَاضْرِبُوا عُنُقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ مِثْلُ الزَّنَادِقَةِ وَأَشْبَاهِهِمْ فَإِنَّ أُولَئِكَ إِذَا ظُهِرَ عَلَيْهِمْ قُتِلُوا وَلَمْ يُسْتَتَابُوا لأَنَّهُ لاَ تُعْرَفُ تَوْبَتُهُمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُسِرُّونَ الْكُفْرَ وَيُعْلِنُونَ الإِسْلاَمَ فَلاَ أَرَى أَنْ يُسْتَتَابَ هَؤُلاَءِ وَلاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمْ قَوْلُهُمْ وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ وَأَظْهَرَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّهُ يُسْتَتَابُ فَإِنْ تَابَ وَإِلاَّ قُتِلَ وَذَلِكَ لَوْ أَنَّ قَوْمًا كَانُوا عَلَى ذَلِكَ رَأَيْتُ أَنْ يُدْعَوْا إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَيُسْتَتَابُوا فَإِنْ تَابُوا قُبِلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُمْ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا قُتِلُوا وَلَمْ يُعْنَ بِذَلِكَ فِيمَا نُرَى وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الْيَهُودِيَّةِ إِلَى النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ وَلاَ مِنَ النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ إِلَى الْيَهُودِيَّةِ وَلاَ مَنْ يُغَيِّرُ دِينَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَدْيَانِ كُلِّهَا إِلاَّ الإِسْلاَمَ فَمَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ وَأَظْهَرَ ذَلِكَ فَذَلِكَ الَّذِي عُنِيَ بِهِ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏
text_translation: ज़ैद बिन असलम से रिवायत है के रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फरमाया जो शख़्स अपना दीन बदल डाले (मुर्तद हो जाए) तो उसकी गर्दन मारो। मालिक ने कहा रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) के इस फरमान का हमारे नज़दीक मतलब ये है के जो मुसलमान इस्लाम से बाहर हो जाए जैसे ज़नादिक़ा या उनकी मानिंद, तो जब मुसलमान उन पर ग़लबा पाएँ तो उन्हें क़त्ल कर दें। ये भी ज़रूरी नहीं के पहले उनसे तौबा करने को कहें क्योंकि उनकी तौबा का ऐतबार नहीं हो सकता, वो कुफ़्र को अपने दिल में रखते हैं और ज़ाहिर में अपने तईं मुसलमान कहते हैं। लेकिन अगर कोई मुसलमान शख़्स किसी शुब्हे की वजह से एलानिया दीन-ए-इस्लाम से फिर जाए, तो उस से तौबा करवाएँ (और जो शुबा हो उसे दूर करें), अगर तौबा करे तो बेहतर वरना क़त्ल किया जाए। और जो काफ़िर एक कुफ़्र के दीन को छोड़ कर दूसरा कुफ़्र का दीन इख़्तियार करे, मिसाल के तौर पर पहले यहूदी था फिर नस्रानी हो जाए, तो उसे क़त्ल नहीं करेंगे, बल्कि जो दीन-ए-इस्लाम को छोड़ कर और कोई दीन इख़्तियार करेगा उसी के लिए ये सज़ा है।

language_versions.text: زید بن اسلم سے روایت ہے کہ فرمایا رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے جو شخص اپنا دین بدل ڈالے تو اس کی گردن مارو۔ کہا مالک نے رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے یہ جو فرمایا جو شخص اپنا دین بدل ڈالے اس کی گردن مارو ہمارے نزدیک اس کے معنی یہ ہیں جو مسلمان اسلام سے باہر ہوجائیں جیسے زنادقہ یا ان کی مانند تو جب مسلمان ان پر غلبہ پائیں تو ان کو قتل کردیں یہ بھی ضروری نہیں کہ پہلے ان سے توبہ کرنے کو کہیں کیونکہ ان کی توبہ کا اعتبار نہیں ہوسکتا وہ کفر کو اپنے دل میں رکھتے ہیں اور ظاہر میں اپنے تئیں مسلمان کہتے ہیں لیکن اگر مسلمان شخص (کسی شبہ کی وجہ سے) علانیہ دین اسلام سے پھر جائے تو اس سے توبہ کرائیں (اور جو شبہ ہوا ہو اس کو دور کردیں) اگر توبہ کرے تو بہتر۔ ورنہ قتل کیا جائے اور جو کافر ایک کفر کے دین کو چھوڑ کر دوسرا کفر کا دین اختیار کرے مثلا پہلے یہودی تھا پھر نصرانی ہوجائے تو اس کو قتل نہ کریں گے بلکہ جو دین اسلام کو چھوڑ کر اور کوئی دین اختیار کرے گا اسی کے لئے یہ سزاہے۔

language_versions.text: Zaid bin Aslam se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo shakhs apna deen badal dale (murtad ho jaye) toh uski gardan maro. Malik ne kaha Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke is farman ka hamare nazdeek matlab ye hai ke jo Musalman Islam se bahar ho jaye jaise Zanadiqa ya unki manind, toh jab Musalman un par ghalba payein toh unhein qatl kar dein. Ye bhi zaroori nahi ke pehle unse tauba karne ko kahein kyunke unki tauba ka aitbar nahi ho sakta, woh kufr ko apne dil mein rakhte hain aur zahir mein apne tayein Musalman kehte hain. Lekin agar koi Musalman shakhs kisi shubhe ki wajah se alaniya deen-e-Islam se phir jaye, toh us se tauba karwayein (aur jo shuba ho use door karein), agar tauba kare toh behtar warna qatl kiya jaye. Aur jo kafir ek kufr ke deen ko chhod kar dusra kufr ka deen ikhtiyar kare, misal ke taur par pehle Yahudi tha phir Nasrani ho jaye, toh use qatl nahi karenge, balki jo deen-e-Islam ko chhod kar aur koi deen ikhtiyar karega usi ke liye ye saza hai.

language_versions.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "What is done in our community about someone who consumed an animal without the permission of its owner, is that he must pay its price on the day he consumed it. He is not obliged to replace it with a similar animal nor does he compensate the owner with any kind of animal. He must pay its price on the day it was consumed, and giving the value is more equitable in compensation for animals and goods." Yahya said that he heard Malik say about someone who consumes some food without the permission of its owner, "He returns to the owner a like weight of the same kind of food. Food is in the position of gold and silver. Gold and silver are returned with gold and silver. The animal is not in the position of gold in that. What distinguishes between them is the sunna and the behaviour which is in force. Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "If a man is entrusted with some wealth and then trades with it for himself and makes a profit, the profit is his because he is responsible for the property until he returns it to its owner. " Yahya related to me from Malik from Zayd ibn Aslam that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, "If someone changes his deen - strike his neck!" The meaning of the statement of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, in our opinion and Allah knows best, is that "if someone changes his deen, strike his neck!" refers to those who leave Islam for other than it - like the heretics and their like, about whom it is known. They are killed without being called to tawba because their tawba is not recognised. They were hiding their kufr and publishing their Islam, so I do not think that one calls such people to tawba, and one does not accept their word. As for the one who goes out of Islam to something else and divulges it, one calls him to tawba. If he does not turn in tawba, he is killed. If there are people in that situation, I think that one should call them to Islam and call them to tawba. If they turn in tawba, that is accepted from them. If they do not turn in tawba, they are killed. That does not refer as we see it, and Allah knows best, to those who come out of Judaism to Christianity or from Christianity to Judaism, nor to someone who changes his deen from the various forms of deen except for Islam. Whoever comes out of Islam to other than it and divulges that, that is the one who is referred to, and Allah knows best

arabic.text: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ غَيَّرَ دِينَهُ فَاضْرِبُوا عُنُقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمَعْنَى قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا نُرَى - وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ - ‏"‏ مَنْ غَيَّرَ دِينَهُ فَاضْرِبُوا عُنُقَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ مِثْلُ الزَّنَادِقَةِ وَأَشْبَاهِهِمْ فَإِنَّ أُولَئِكَ إِذَا ظُهِرَ عَلَيْهِمْ قُتِلُوا وَلَمْ يُسْتَتَابُوا لأَنَّهُ لاَ تُعْرَفُ تَوْبَتُهُمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُسِرُّونَ الْكُفْرَ وَيُعْلِنُونَ الإِسْلاَمَ فَلاَ أَرَى أَنْ يُسْتَتَابَ هَؤُلاَءِ وَلاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمْ قَوْلُهُمْ وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ وَأَظْهَرَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّهُ يُسْتَتَابُ فَإِنْ تَابَ وَإِلاَّ قُتِلَ وَذَلِكَ لَوْ أَنَّ قَوْمًا كَانُوا عَلَى ذَلِكَ رَأَيْتُ أَنْ يُدْعَوْا إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَيُسْتَتَابُوا فَإِنْ تَابُوا قُبِلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُمْ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا قُتِلُوا وَلَمْ يُعْنَ بِذَلِكَ فِيمَا نُرَى وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الْيَهُودِيَّةِ إِلَى النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ وَلاَ مِنَ النَّصْرَانِيَّةِ إِلَى الْيَهُودِيَّةِ وَلاَ مَنْ يُغَيِّرُ دِينَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَدْيَانِ كُلِّهَا إِلاَّ الإِسْلاَمَ فَمَنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ وَأَظْهَرَ ذَلِكَ فَذَلِكَ الَّذِي عُنِيَ بِهِ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏

comments.text: मुहम्मद बिन अब्दुल्लाह बिन अब्दुल क़ारी से रिवायत है के हज़रत उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) के पास एक शख़्स आया अबू मूसा अशअरी (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) के पास से। हज़रत उमर ने उस से वहाँ के लोगों का हाल पूछा, उसने बयान किया। फिर हज़रत उमर ने कहा तुम को कोई नादिर चीज़ मालूम है? वो शख़्स बोला हाँ, एक शख़्स काफ़िर हो गया था बाद इस्लाम के। हज़रत उमर ने पूछा तुम ने उस से क्या किया? वो शख़्स बोला हम ने उसे पकड़ा और उसकी गर्दन मार दी। हज़रत उमर ने कहा तुम ने उसको तीन दिन तक क़ैद किया होता और हर रोज़ रोटी दी होती, फिर तौबा करवाई होती, शायद वो तौबा करता और फिर अल्लाह के हुक्म मान लेता। फिर हज़रत उमर ने फरमाया या अल्लाह! मैं उस वक़्त वहाँ मौजूद न था, न मैंने हुक्म दिया, न मैं ख़ुश हुआ जब मुझे मालूम हुआ।

comments.text: محمد بن عبداللہ بن عبدالقاری سے روایت ہے کہ حضرت عمر کے پاس ایک شخص آیا ابوموسیٰ اشعری کے پاس سے حضرت عمر نے اس سے وہاں کے لوگوں کا حال پوچھا اس نے بیان کیا پھر حضرت عمر نے کہا تم کو کوئی نادر چیز معلوم ہے وہ شخص بولا ہاں ایک شخص کافر ہو گیا تھا بعد اسلام کے حضرت عمر نے پوچھا تم نے اس سے کیا کیا وہ شخص بولا ہم نے اسے پکڑا اور اس کی گردن ماردی حضرت عمر نے کہا تم نے اس کو تین دن تک قید کیا ہوتا اور ہر روز روٹی دی ہوتی پھر توبہ کروائی ہوتی شائدوہ توبہ کرتا اور پھر اللہ کے حکم مان لیتا پھر حضرت عمر نے فرمایا یا اللہ میں اس وقت وہاں موجود نہ تھا مں نے حکم کیا نہ میں خوش ہوا جب کہ مجھے معلوم ہوا۔

comments.text: Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Abdul Qari se riwayat hai ke Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ke paas ek shakhs aaya Abu Musa Ash'ari (Radi Allahu Anhu) ke paas se. Hazrat Umar ne us se wahan ke logon ka haal pucha, usne bayan kiya. Phir Hazrat Umar ne kaha tum ko koi nadir cheez maloom hai? Woh shakhs bola haan, ek shakhs kafir ho gaya tha baad Islam ke. Hazrat Umar ne pucha tum ne us se kya kiya? Woh shakhs bola hum ne use pakda aur uski gardan maar di. Hazrat Umar ne kaha tum ne usko teen din tak qaid kiya hota aur har roz roti di hoti, phir tauba karwayi hoti, shayad woh tauba karta aur phir Allah ke hukum maan leta. Phir Hazrat Umar ne farmaya ya Allah! Main us waqt wahan maujood na tha, na maine hukum diya, na main khush hua jab mujhe maloom hua.

comments.text: Sunain bin Abi Jamila ne ek manbooz (la-waris bacha) paya Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ke zamane mein. Unhone kaha main usko Hazrat Umar ke paas le aaya. Hazrat Umar ne pucha tum ne usko kyun uthaya? Maine kaha ye pade pade mar jata is waste maine utha liya. Itne mein Hazrat Umar ke areef ne kaha ae Ameer-ul-Momineen, main is shakhs ko janta hoon, nek aadmi hai. Hazrat Umar ne kaha nek hai? Usne kaha haan. Hazrat Umar ne kaha jao, manbooz azad hai, tujh ko uski wala (haq-e-wirasat) milegi aur hum uska kharch denge. Malik ne kaha manbooz azad rahega aur wala uski Musalmanon ko milegi, wahi uske waris honge wahi uski taraf se diyat bhi denge.

language_versions.text: Yahya said that Malik related from Ibn Shihab that Sunayn Abi Jamila, a man from the Banu Sulaym, found an abandoned child in the time of Umar ibn al-Khattab. Sunayn took him to Umar ibn al-Khattab. He asked, "What has induced you to take this person?" He answered, "I found him lost, so I took him.'' Umar's advisor said to him,' 'Amir al-Muminin! He is a man who does good." Umar inquired of him, "Is it so?" He replied, "Yes." Umar ibn al-Khattab said, "Go, he is free, and you have his wala' inheritance, and we will provide for him."

title: Chapter 36
text_arabic: قَالَ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ عُتْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَهِدَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ مِنِّي فَاقْبِضْهُ إِلَيْكَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عَامُ الْفَتْحِ أَخَذَهُ سَعْدٌ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَخِي قَدْ كَانَ عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ فِيهِ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ فَقَالَ أَخِي وَابْنُ وَلِيدَةِ أَبِي وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ ‏.‏ فَتَسَاوَقَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ابْنُ أَخِي قَدْ كَانَ عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ فِيهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ بْنُ زَمْعَةَ أَخِي وَابْنُ وَلِيدَةِ أَبِي وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هُوَ لَكَ يَا عَبْدُ بْنَ زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِسَوْدَةَ بِنْتِ زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏ احْتَجِبِي مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لِمَا رَأَى مِنْ شَبَهِهِ بِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَتْ فَمَا رَآهَا حَتَّى لَقِيَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏
text_translation: हज़रत आयशा (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हा) से रिवायत है के उत्बाह बिन अबी वक़्क़ास ने मरते वक़्त अपने भाई साअद बिन अबी वक़्क़ास से कहा के ज़माअह की लौंडी का लड़का मेरे नुत्फ़ा से है तो उसको अपने पास रखियो। जब मक्का फ़तह हुआ तो साअद ने उस लड़के को ले लिया और कहा ये मेरे भाई का बेटा है, उसने वसीयत की थी इसके लेने की। अब्द-ए-ज़माअह ने कहा ये लड़का मेरा भाई है, मेरे बाप की लौंडी का बेटा है। दोनों ने झगड़ा किया तो रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) के पास गए। साअद ने कहा या रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ये बेटा है मेरे भाई का, उसने मुझे वसीयत की थी और मेरे बाप की लौंडी से पैदा हुआ है। रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने अब्द-ए-ज़माअह से फरमाया के ये लड़का तेरा है, फिर फरमाया लड़का माँ के ख़ावंद या मालिक का होता है और ज़िना करने वाले के लिए पत्थर (सज़ा) है। फिर सौदा बिंत ज़माअह से कहा के तू इस लड़के से पर्दा किया कर क्योंकि वो लड़का मुशाबाह था उत्बाह बिन अबी वक़्क़ास के, सो उस लड़के ने न देखा सौदा को यहाँ तक के उसका इंतेक़ाल हो गया।

language_versions.text: حضرت عائشہ رضی اللہ تعالیٰ عنہا سے روایت ہے کہ عتبہ بن ابی وقاص نے مرتے وقت اپنے بھائی سعد بن ابی وقاص سے کہا کہ زمعہ کی لونڈی کا لڑکا میرے نطفہ سے ہے تو اس کو اپنے پاس رکھیوں تو جب مکہ فتح ہوا تو سعد نے اس لڑکے کو لے لیا اور کہا میرے بھائی کا بیٹا ہے اس نے وصیت کی تھی اس کے لینے کی عبد زمعہ نے کہا یہ لڑکا میرا بھائی ہے میرے باپ کی لونڈی کا بیٹا ہے دونوں نے جھگڑا کیا رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے پاس سعد نے کہا یا رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم یہ بیٹا ہے میرے بھائی کا اس نے مجھے وصیت کی تھی اور میرے باپ کی لونڈی سے پیدا ہوا ہے رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے فرمایا عبد زمعہ سے کہ یہ لڑکا تیرا ہے پھر فرمایا لڑکا ماں کے خاوند یا مالک کا ہوتا ہے اور زنا کرنے والے کے لئے پتھر ہیں پھر سودہ بنت زمعہ سے کہا کہ تو اس لڑکے سے پردہ کیا کر کیونکہ وہ لڑکا مشابہ تھا عتبہ بن ابی وقاص کے سو اس لڑکے نے نہ دیکھا سودہ کر یہاں تک کہ انتقال ہوا اس کا ۔

language_versions.text: Hazrat Ayesha (Radi Allahu Anha) se riwayat hai ke Utbah bin Abi Waqqas ne marte waqt apne bhai Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas se kaha ke Zama'ah ki laundi ka ladka mere nutfa se hai toh usko apne paas rakhiyo. Jab Makkah fatah hua toh Sa'ad ne us ladke ko le liya aur kaha ye mere bhai ka beta hai, usne wasiyat ki thi iske lene ki. Abd-e-Zama'ah ne kaha ye ladka mera bhai hai, mere baap ki laundi ka beta hai. Dono ne jhagda kiya toh Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas gaye. Sa'ad ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ye beta hai mere bhai ka, usne mujhe wasiyat ki thi aur mere baap ki laundi se paida hua hai. Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Abd-e-Zama'ah se farmaya ke ye ladka tera hai, phir farmaya ladka maa ke khawand ya maalik ka hota hai aur zina karne wale ke liye patthar (saza) hai. Phir Saudah bint Zama'ah se kaha ke tu is ladke se parda kiya kar kyunke wo ladka mushabah tha Utbah bin Abi Waqqas ke, so us ladke ne na dekha Saudah ko yahan tak ke uska inteqal ho gaya.

language_versions.text: Yahya said from Malik from Ibn Shihab from Urwa ibn az-Zubayr that A'isha, the wife of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, ''Utba ibn Abi Waqqas disclosed to his brother, Sad ibn Abi Waqqas, that he was the father of the son of the slave-girl of Zama, and made him promise to look after him (after his death). In the year of the conquest, Sad took him and said, 'He is the son of my brother. He covenanted with me about him.' Abd ibn Zama stood up and said, 'He is my brother and the son of my father's slave-girl. He was born on his bed.' They went to the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. Sad said, 'Messenger of Allah! He is the son of my brother, he made a covenant with me about him.' Abd ibn Zama said, 'He is my brother and the son of my father's slave-girl and was born on my father's bed.' The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, 'He is yours, Abd ibn Zama.' Then the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, 'A child belongs to the household (where he was born) and the adulterer is stoned.' Then he told Sawda bint Zama, 'Veil yourself from him,' since he saw in him a resemblance to Utba ibn Abi Waqqas." A'isha added, "He did not see her until he met Allah, the Mighty, the Majestic

comments.text: अब्दुल्ला बिन उमय्याह से रिवायत है के एक औरत का ख़ावंद मर गया तो उसने चार महीने दस दिन तक इद्दत की, फिर दूसरे शख़्स से निकाह कर लिया। अभी उसके पास सड़हे चार महीने रही थी के एक लड़का जना (पैदा किया) जो बिल्कुल पूरा था। तो उसका ख़ावंद हज़रत उमर (रदी अल्लाहु अन्हु) के पास आया और उसने ये हाल बयान किया। हज़रत उमर (रदी अल्लाहु अन्हु) ने अपनी पुरानी औरतों को जो जाहिलियत के ज़माने में थीं बुलवाया और उनसे पूछा। उन में से एक औरत बोली मैं तुमको इस औरत का हाल बताती हूँ, ये हामिला हो गई थी अपने पहले ख़ावंद से जो मर गया, तो हैज़ का ख़ून बच्चे पर पड़ते पड़ते वो बच्चा सूख गया था उसके पेट में। तो जब उसने दूसरा निकाह किया और मर की मुह पहुँचा तो फिर बच्चे को हरकत हुई और बड़ा हो गया। हज़रत उमर (रदी अल्लाहु अन्हु) ने इसकी तस्दीक़ की और निकाह तोड़ डाला तो फ़रमाया के ख़ैर हुई तुम्हारी, कोई बुरी बात मुझे नहीं पहुँची और लड़के का नसब पहले ख़ावंद से साबित किया।

comments.text: Abdullah bin Umayyah se riwayat hai ke ek aurat ka khawand mar gaya toh usne chaar mahine das din tak iddat ki, phir dusre shakhs se nikah kar liya. Abhi uske paas sadhe chaar mahine rahi thi ke ek ladka jana (paida kiya) jo bilkul pura tha. Toh uska khawand Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ke paas aaya aur usne ye haal bayan kiya. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne apni purani auraton ko jo jahiliyat ke zamane mein thin bulwaya aur unse pucha. Un mein se ek aurat boli main tumko is aurat ka haal batati hoon, ye hamila ho gayi thi apne pehle khawand se jo mar gaya, toh haiz ka khoon bache par padte padte wo bacha sookh gaya tha uske pait mein. Toh jab usne dusra nikah kiya aur mar ki muh pahuncha toh phir bache ko harkat hui aur bada ho gaya. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne iski tasdeeq ki aur nikah tod dala toh farmaya ke khair hui tumhari, koi buri baat mujhe nahi pahunchi aur ladke ka nasab pehle khawand se sabit kiya.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me from Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn al-Hadi from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn al-Harith at-Taymi from Sulayman ibn Yasar from Abdullah ibn Abi Umayya that a woman's husband died, and she did the idda of four months and ten days. Then she married when she was free to marry. She stayed with her husband for four and a half months, then gave birth to a fully developed child. Her husband went to Umar ibn al-Khattab and mentioned that to him, so Umar called some of the old women of the Jahiliyya and asked them about that. One of the women said, "I will tell you what happened with this woman. When her husband died, she was pregnant by him, but then the blood flowed from her because of his death and the child became dry in her womb. When her new husband had intercourse with her and the water reached the child, the child moved in the womb and grew." Umar ibn al-Khattab believed her and separated them. Umar said, "Only good has reached me about you two," and he connected the child to the first husband

comments.text: Sulaiman bin Yasar se riwayat hai ke Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) jahiliyat ke bachon ko jo unka da'wa karta Islam ke zamane mein usi se mila dete. Ek baar do aadmi da'wa karte hue aaye ek ladke ka, Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne Qa'if (nasab pehchanne wale) ko bulaya. Qa'if ne dekh kar kaha is ladke mein dono shareek hain. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne Qa'if ko darre se mara, phir us aurat ko bulaya aur kaha tu apna haal mujhse keh. Usne ek mard ki taraf ishara karke kaha ke ye mere paas aata tha aur main apne logon ke unton mein hoti thi toh wo mujhse alag nahi hota tha balki mujhse chimta rehta tha yahan tak ke wo bhi aur main bhi guman karte hamal reh jane ka, phir wo jata aur mujhe khoon aaya karta tab dusra mard aata wo bhi sohbat karta, main nahi janti in dono mein se ye kiska nutfa hai. Qa'if ye sun kar khushi ke mare phool gaya. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha ladke se tujhe ikhtiyar hai jisse chahe in dono mein se molat kar le.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me from Yahya ibn Said from Sulayman ibn Yasar that Umar ibn al-Khattab used to attach the children of the Jahiliyya to whoever claimed them in Islam. Two men came and each of them claimed a woman's child. Umar ibn al-Khattab summoned a person who scrutinized features and he looked at them. The scrutinizer said, "They both share in him." Umar ibn al-Khattab hit him with a whip. Then he summoned the woman, and said, "Tell me your tale." She said, "It was this one who used to come to me while I was with my people's camels. comments.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "The way of doing things generally agreed upon in our community in the case of a man who dies and has sons and one of them claims, 'My father confirmed that so-and- so was his son,' is that the relationship is not established by the testimony of one man, and the confirmation of the one who confirmed it is only permitted as regards his own share in the division of his father's property. The one testified for is only given his due from the share of the testifier." Malik said, "An example of this is that a man dies leaving two sons, and 600 dinars. Each of them takes 300 dinars. Then one of them testifies that his deceased father confirmed that so-and-so was his son. The one who testifies is obliged to give 100 dinars to the one thus connected. This is half of the inheritance of the one thought to be related, had he been related. If the other confirms him, he takes the other 100 and so he completes his right and his relationship is established. His position is similar to that of a woman who confirms a debt against her father or her husband and the other heirs deny it. She must pay to the person whose debt she confirms, the amount according to her share of the full debt, had it been confirmed against all the heirs. If the woman inherits an eighth, she pays the creditor an eighth of his debt. If a daughter inherits a half, she pays the creditor half of his debt. Whichever women confirm him, pay him according to this. Malik said, "If a man's testimony is in agreement with what the woman testified to, that so- and-so had a debt against his father, the creditor is made to take an oath with one witness and he is given all his due. This is not the position with women because a man's testimony is allowed and the creditor must take an oath with the testimony of his witness, and take all his due. If he does not take an oath, he only takes from the inheritance of the one who confirmed him according to his share of the debt, because he confirmed his right and the other heirs denied it. It is permitted for him to confirm it."

comments.text: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ الضَّحَّاكَ بْنَ خَلِيفَةَ، سَاقَ خَلِيجًا لَهُ مِنَ الْعُرَيْضِ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَمُرَّ بِهِ فِي أَرْضِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ فَأَبَى مُحَمَّدٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ الضَّحَّاكُ لِمَ تَمْنَعُنِي وَهُوَ لَكَ مَنْفَعَةٌ تَشْرَبُ بِهِ أَوَّلاً وَآخِرًا وَلاَ يَضُرُّكَ ‏.‏ فَأَبَى مُحَمَّدٌ فَكَلَّمَ فِيهِ الضَّحَّاكُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَدَعَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ مَسْلَمَةَ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُخَلِّيَ سَبِيلَهُ فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ لاَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لِمَ تَمْنَعُ أَخَاكَ مَا يَنْفَعُهُ وَهُوَ لَكَ نَافِعٌ تَسْقِي بِهِ أَوَّلاً وَآخِرًا وَهُوَ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ لاَ وَاللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ وَاللَّهِ لَيَمُرَّنَّ بِهِ وَلَوْ عَلَى بَطْنِكَ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَهُ عُمَرُ أَنْ يَمُرَّ بِهِ فَفَعَلَ الضَّحَّاكُ ‏.‏

comments.text: याहया बिन अमराह से रिवायत है के दाहक बिन खलीफा ने एक नहर निकली अर्ज़ में से में से हो कर. उन्होंने मना किया. दाहक ने कहा तुम क्यों मन करते हो? तुम्हारा तो इस में नफा है अव्वल और आखिर पानी दिया करना और कुछ ज़रर नहीं. मुहम्मद (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने न मन. दाहक ने हज़रात उम्र (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) से बयां किया. हज़रात उम्र (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने मुहम्मद बिन मसलमा को बुला कर कहा: तुम इजाज़त दो. मुहम्मद (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने कहा: मैं न दूंगा. हज़रात उम्र (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने कहा: तुम अपने भाई मुसलमान को ऐसी बात से मना करते हो जिस में उसका नफ़ा है और तुम्हारा भी नफा है? तुम भी पानी लिया करना अव्वल और आखिर में और तुम्हारा कुछ ज़रर नहीं. मुहम्मद (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने कहा: क़सम अल्लाह की (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने कहा: वह नहर बहायी जाये अगरचे तुम्हारे पेट पर से हो. फिर हज़रात उम्र (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने दाहक को हुकुम किया नहर जारी करने का मुहम्मद बिन मसलमा की ज़मीन से हो कर. दाहक ने ऐसा ही किया.

comments.text: Yahya bin Amarah se riwayat hai ke Dahhak bin Khalifa ne ek nahar nikali arz mein se, Muhammad bin Maslama ki zameen mein se ho kar. Unhone mana kiya. Dahhak ne kaha tum kyun mana karte ho? Tumhara to is mein nafa hai, apni zameen ko awwal aur aakhir pani diya karna aur kuch zarar nahi. Muhammad (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne na mana. Dahhak ne Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) se bayan kiya. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne Muhammad bin Maslama ko bula kar kaha: Tum ijazat do. Muhammad (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha: Main na dunga. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha: Tum apne bhai musalman ko aisi baat se mana karte ho jis mein uska nafa hai aur tumhara bhi nafa hai? Tum bhi pani liya karna awwal aur aakhir mein aur tumhara kuch zarar nahi. Muhammad (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha: Qasam Allah ki, main ijazat na dunga. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha: Woh nahar bahayi jaye agarche tumhare pet par se ho. Phir Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne Dahhak ko hukum kiya nahar jaari karne ka Muhammad bin Maslama ki zameen se ho kar. Dahhak ne aisa hi kiya.

You can drink from it first and last and it will not harm you." title: Chapter 36
text_arabic: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الدِّيلِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا دَارٍ أَوْ أَرْضٍ قُسِمَتْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَهِيَ عَلَى قَسْمِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَأَيُّمَا دَارٍ أَوْ أَرْضٍ أَدْرَكَهَا الإِسْلاَمُ وَلَمْ تُقْسَمْ فَهِيَ عَلَى قَسْمِ الإِسْلاَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا يَقُولُ فِيمَنْ هَلَكَ وَتَرَكَ أَمْوَالاً بِالْعَالِيَةِ وَالسَّافِلَةِ إِنَّ الْبَعْلَ لاَ يُقْسَمُ مَعَ النَّضْحِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَرْضَى أَهْلُهُ بِذَلِكَ وَإِنَّ الْبَعْلَ يُقْسَمُ مَعَ الْعَيْنِ إِذَا كَانَ يُشْبِهُهَا وَأَنَّ الأَمْوَالَ إِذَا كَانَتْ بِأَرْضٍ وَاحِدَةٍ الَّذِي بَيْنَهُمَا مُتَقَارِبٌ أَنَّهُ يُقَامُ كُلُّ مَالٍ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ يُقْسَمُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَالْمَسَاكِنُ وَالدُّورُ بِهَذِهِ الْمَنْزِلَةِ ‏.‏
text_translation: थौर बिन जैद वाइली से रिवायत है के रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया: जो ज़मीन या मकान जाहिलियत के ज़माने में तक़सीम हो चुका है वो इसी तौर पर रहेगा। अलबता जो मकान या ज़मीन इस्लाम के ज़माने तक तक़सीम नहीं हुई, तो वो इस्लाम के क़ायदों के मुवाफ़िक़ तक़सीम होगी। कहा मालिक ने: अगर एक शख़्स मर जाए और बारानी और चाही ज़मीनें छोड़ जाए तो बारानी को चाही के साथ मिला कर तक़सीम न करेंगे बल्कि जुदा जुदा तक़सीम करेंगे (क्यूँके बारानी का लगान दसवां हिस्सा और चाही का बीसवां हिस्सा पैदावार का है), मगर जब सब शरीक मिला कर तक़सीम करने पर राज़ी हो जाएं तो मिला कर तक़सीम कर देंगे। अलबता बारानी और ज़ेर-ए-तलब या क रीज़ को मिला कर तक़सीम कर देंगे (क्यूँके उनका धारा एक है, यानी दोनों क़िस्म की ज़मीनों का लगान पैदावार का दसवां हिस्सा है)। इसी तरह अगर किसी क़िस्म के माल हो एक ही जगह और एक दूसरे के मुशाबा हो, तो हर एक माल की क़ीमत लगा कर एक साथ तक़सीम कर देंगे, मकानों और घरों का भी यही हुक्म है।

language_versions.text: ثور بن زید ویلی سے روایت ہے کہ رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے فرمایا جو زمین یا مکان جاہلیت کے زمانے میں تقسیم ہو چکا ہے وہ اسی طور پر رہیگا البتہ جو مکان یا زمین اسلام کے زمانے تک تقسیم نہیں ہوئی تو وہ اسلام کے قاعدوں کے موافق تقسیم ہوگی ۔ کہا مالک نے اگر ایک شخص مرجائے اور بارانی اور چاہی زمینیں چھوڑ جائے تو بارانی کو چاہی کے ساتھ ملا کر تقسیم نہ کریں گے بلکہ جدا جداتقسیم کریں گے۔ (کیونکہ بارانی کا لگان دسواں حصہ اور چاہی کا بیسواں حصہ پیداوار کا) مگر جب سب شریک ملا کر تقسیم کرنے پر راضی ہوجائیں تو ملا کر تقسیم کردیں گے البتہ بارانی اور زیر تالاب یا کاریز کو ملا کر تقسیم کردیں گے ۔ (کیونکہ ان کا دھارا ایک ہے یعنی دونوں قسموں کی زمینوں کا لگان پیداوار کا دسواں حصہ ہے اسی طرح اگر کسی قسم کے مال ہوں ایک ہی جگہ اور ایک دوسرے کے مشابہ ہوں تو ہر ایک مال کی قیمت لگا کر ایک ساتھ تقسیم کردیں گے مکانوں اور گھروں کا بھی یہی حکم ہے۔)

language_versions.text: Thawr bin Zaid Waili se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Jo zameen ya makan jahiliyat ke zamane mein taqseem ho chuka hai woh isi taur par rahega. Albata jo makan ya zameen Islam ke zamane tak taqseem nahi hui, to woh Islam ke qaido ke muwafiq taqseem hogi. Kaha Malik ne: Agar ek shakhs marjaye aur barani aur chahi zameenein chhod jaye to barani ko chahi ke saath mila kar taqseem na karenge balki juda juda taqseem karenge (kyunke barani ka lagan daswan hissa aur chahi ka beeswan hissa paidawar ka hai), magar jab sab shareek mila kar taqseem karne par raazi hojayein to mila kar taqseem kardenge. Albata barani aur zer-e-talab ya kareez ko mila kar taqseem kardenge (kyunke unka dhara ek hai, yani dono qismo ki zameeno ka lagan paidawar ka daswan hissa hai). Isi tarah agar kisi qism ke maal ho ek hi jagah aur ek dusre ke mushaba ho, to har ek maal ki qeemat laga kar ek saath taqseem kardenge, makanon aur gharon ka bhi yahi hukum hai.

arabic.text: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الدِّيلِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا دَارٍ أَوْ أَرْضٍ قُسِمَتْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَهِيَ عَلَى قَسْمِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَأَيُّمَا دَارٍ أَوْ أَرْضٍ أَدْرَكَهَا الإِسْلاَمُ وَلَمْ تُقْسَمْ فَهِيَ عَلَى قَسْمِ الإِسْلاَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا يَقُولُ فِيمَنْ هَلَكَ وَتَرَكَ أَمْوَالاً بِالْعَالِيَةِ وَالسَّافِلَةِ إِنَّ الْبَعْلَ لاَ يُقْسَمُ مَعَ النَّضْحِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَرْضَى أَهْلُهُ بِذَلِكَ وَإِنَّ الْبَعْلَ يُقْسَمُ مَعَ الْعَيْنِ إِذَا كَانَ يُشْبِهُهَا وَأَنَّ الأَمْوَالَ إِذَا كَانَتْ بِأَرْضٍ وَاحِدَةٍ الَّذِي بَيْنَهُمَا مُتَقَارِبٌ أَنَّهُ يُقَامُ كُلُّ مَالٍ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ يُقْسَمُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَالْمَسَاكِنُ وَالدُّورُ بِهَذِهِ الْمَنْزِلَةِ ‏.‏

comments.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik speak about a man who died and left properties in Aliya and Safila (outlying districts of Madina). He said, "Unirrigated naturally watered land is not in the same category as irrigated land unless the family are satisfied with that. Unirrigated land is only in the same category as land with a spring when it resembles it. When the properties are in one land, and are close together, each individual property is evaluated and then divided between the heirs. Dwellings and houses are in the same position."

comments.text: यह्या बिन अब्दुर्रहमान बिन हातिब से रिवायत है के गुलामों ने एक शख़्स का ऊंट चुरा कर काट डाला। जब यह मुक़दमा हज़रत उमर (रज़ी अल्लाहू अन्हु) के पास गया, आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने कसीर बिन सल्ट से कहा: इन गुलामों का हाथ काट डाल। फिर हातिब से कहा: मैं समझता हूँ के तू इन गुलामों को भूका रखता होगा। फिर हज़रत उमर (रज़ी अल्लाहू अन्हु) ने हातिब से कहा: क़सम अल्लाह की, मैं तुझसे ऐसा तावान दिलाऊंगा जो तुझ पर बहुत गिरां गुज़रे। आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने ऊंट वाले से पूछा तेरा ऊंट कितने का होगा? उसने कहा मैं ने चार सौ दिरहम को इसे नहीं बेचा। हज़रत उमर (रज़ी अल्लाहू अन्हु) ने कहा: तू आठ सौ दिरहम इसके दे। कहा मालिक ने: हमारे नज़दीक क़ीमत दोचंद लेने में इस रिवायत पर अमल न होगा, लेकिन दर-आमद लोगों की यह रही के उस जानवर की जो क़ीमत चुराने के दिन होगी वो देनी होगी।

comments.text: Yahya bin Abdurrahman bin Hatib se riwayat hai ke ghulamon ne ek shakhs ka unt chura kar kaat dala. Jab yeh muqadma Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ke paas gaya, aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Kathir bin Salt se kaha: In ghulamon ka haath kaat daal. Phir Hatib se kaha: Main samajhta hoon ke tu in ghulamon ko bhooka rakhta hoga. Phir Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne Hatib se kaha: Qasam Allah ki, main tujhse aisa tawan dilaunga jo tujh par bahut giraan guzre. Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unt wale se pucha tera unt kitne ka hoga? Usne kaha main ne char sau dirham ko ise nahi becha. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha: Tu aath sau dirham iske de. Kaha Malik ne: Humare nazdeek qeemat dochand lene mein is riwayat par amal na hoga, lekin dar-amad logon ki yeh rahi ke us janwar ki jo qeemat churane ke din hogi woh deni hogi.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me from Hisham ibn Urwa from his father from Yahya ibn Abd ar-Rahman ibn Hatib that some slaves of Hatib stole a she-camel belonging to a man from the Muzayna tribe and they slaughtered it. The case was brought before Umar ibn al-Khattab, and Umar ordered Kathir ibn as-Salt to cut off their hands. Then Umar said to Habib, "I think you must be starving them," and he added, "By Allah! I will make you pay such a fine that it will be heavy for you." He enquired of the man from the Muzayna tribe, "What was the price of your camel?" The Muzayni said, "By Allah, I refused to sell her for 400 dirhams.'' Umar said, ''Give him 800 dirhams."

text_translation: नोमान बिन बशीर से रिवायत है के मेरे बाप मुझ को रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) के पास लेकर आये और कहा: या रसूल अल्लाह! मैं ने इस बेटे को अपना एक घुलम हीबा किया है. रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया: क्या सब बेटों को तूने ऐसा ही घुलम दिया? बोलै: नहीं. तो आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया: रुजू कर हिबा से.

language_versions.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "What is done in our community about injury to a domestic animal, is that the one who injures it must pay the amount by which he has diminished the animal's price." Yahya said that he heard Malik speak about a camel who attacked a man and he feared for himself and killed it or hamstrung it. He said, "If he has a clear proof that it was heading for him and had attacked him, there are no damages against him. If there is no clear proof except his word, he is responsible for the camel." Yahya related that he heard Malik say that if a man gave a washer a garment to dye and he dyed it, and then the owner of the garment said, "I did not order you to use this dye," and the washer protested that he had done so, then the washer was to be believed. It was the same with the tailor and the gold-smith. They took an oath about it unless they produced something they would not normally have been employed to do. In that situation their statement was not allowed and the owner of the garment had to take an oath . If he rejected it and refused to swear, then the dyer was made to take an oath. Yahya said, "I heard Malik speak about a dyer who was given a garment and he made a mistake and gave it to another man and the one to whom he gave it wore it. He said, 'The one who wore it has no damages against him, and the washer pays damages to the owner of the garment. That is when the man wears the garment which was given him without recognizing that it is not his. If he wears it knowing that it is not his garment, he is responsible for it.' " Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "What is done in our community about a man who refers a creditor to another man for the debt he owes him is that if the one referred to goes bankrupt or dies, and does not leave enough to pay the debt, then the creditor has nothing against the one who referred him and the debt does not return to the first party." Malik said, "This is the way of doing things about which there is no dispute in our community." Malik said, "If a man has his debt to somebody taken on for him by another man and then the man who took it on dies or goes bankrupt, then whatever was taken on by him returns to the first debtor." Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "If a man buys a garment which has a defect, a burn or something else, which the seller knows about and that is testified against him or he confirms it, and the man who has bought it causes a new tear which decreases the price of the garment, and then he learns about the original defect, he can return it to the seller and he is not liable for his tearing it. "If a man buys a garment which has a defect of a burn or flaw, and the one who sold it to him claims that he did not know about it, and the buyer has cut the garment or dyed it, then the buyer has an option . If he wishes, he can have a reduction according to what the burn or flaw detracts from the price of the garment and he can keep the garment, or if he wishes to pay damages for what the cutting or dyeing has decreased of the price of the garment and return it, he can do so. "If the buyer has dyed the garment with a dye which increases the value, the buyer has an option. If he wishes, he has a reduction from the price of the garment according to what the defect diminishes or if he wishes to become a partner with the one who sold the garment he does so. The price of the garment with a burn or flaw is looked at. If the price is ten dirhams, and the amount by which the dyeing increased the value is five dirhams, then they are partners in the garment, each according to his share. In this reckoning is the amount by which the dyeing increases the price of the garment." comments.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "What is done in our community about some one who gives a gift not intending a reward is that he calls witnesses to it. It is affirmed for the one to whom it has been given unless the giver dies before the one to whom it was given receives the gift." He said, "If the giver wants to keep the gift after he has had it witnessed, he cannot. If the recipient claims it from him, he takes it." Malik said, "If some one gives a gift and then withdraws it and the recipient brings a witness to testify for him that he was given the gift, be it goods, gold, silver or animals, the recipient is made to take an oath. If he refuses, the giver is made to take an oath. If he also refuses to take an oath, he gives to the recipient what he claims from him if he has at least one witness. If he does not have a witness, he has nothing . " Malik said, "If someone gives a gift not expecting anything in return and then the recipient dies, the heirs are in his place. If the giver dies before the recipient has received his gift, the recipient has nothing. That is because he was given a gift which he did not take possession of. If the giver wants to keep it, and he has called witnesses to the gift, he cannot do that. If the recipient claims his right he takes it."

title: Chapter 36
text_arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أُعْمِرَ عُمْرَى لَهُ وَلِعَقِبِهِ فَإِنَّهَا لِلَّذِي يُعْطَاهَا لاَ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى الَّذِي أَعْطَاهَا أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لأَنَّهُ أَعْطَى عَطَاءً وَقَعَتْ فِيهِ الْمَوَارِيثُ ‏.‏
text_translation: जाबिर बिन अब्दुल्लाह अंसारी (रदी अल्लाहु अन्हु) से रिवायत है के रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फरमाया, जो शख्स किसी को उमरा (तोहफे के तौर पर जिंदगी भर के लिए देना) दे, उसके वास्ते और उसके वारिसों के वास्ते, तोह फिर वोह उमरा उसी का हो जाता है, देने वाले को फिर नहीं मिल सकता।

language_versions.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "The way of doing things in our community about which there is no dispute, is that if a man gives sadaqa to his son - sadaqa which the son takes possession of or which is in the father's keeping and the father has had his sadaqa witnessed, he cannot take back any of it because he cannot reclaim any sadaqa." Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "The generally agreed-on way of doing things in our community in the case of someone who gives his son a gift or grants him a gift which is not sadaqa is that he can take it back as long as the child does not start a debt, which people claim from him, and which they trust him for on the strength of the gift his father has given him. The father cannot take back anything from the gift after debts are started against it. "If a man gives his son or daughter something and a woman marries the man, and she only marries him for the wealth and the property which his father has given him and so the father wants to take that back, or, if a man marries a woman whose father has given her a gift and he marries her with an increased bride-price because of the wealth and property that her father has given, then the father says, 'I will take that back,' then the father cannot take back any of that from the son or daughter if it is as I have described to you." Malik related to me from Ibn Shihab from Abu Salama ibn Abd ar- Rahman ibn Awf from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, "If someone is given a life pension, for him and his posterity, it belongs to the person to whom it has been given. It never reverts to the one who gave it because he gave a gift and the rules of inheritance apply to it

title: Chapter 36
text_arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْرِفْ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا ثُمَّ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا وَإِلاَّ فَشَأْنَكَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَالَّةُ الْغَنَمِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَالَّةُ الإِبِلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا مَعَهَا سِقَاؤُهَا وَحِذَاؤُهَا تَرِدُ الْمَاءَ وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ حَتَّى يَلْقَاهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
text_translation: जैद बिन खालिद जुहानी (रदी अल्लाहु अन्हु) से रिवायत है के एक शख्स आया रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) के पास और पूछा आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) से लुक्ता (गिरी हुई चीज़) के बारे में। आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फरमाया, पहचान रख तरफ उसके लुक्ते की, ख्वाह चमड़े में हो या कपड़े में, और पहचान रख बंधन उसका, फिर एक बरस तक लोगों से उसका हाल कहा कर, अगर उसका मालिक मिल जाए तोह उसके दे दे, नहीं तोह ले ले। फिर उसने कहा, अगर कोई बकरी बहकी भटकी मिल जाए या रसूल अल्लाह? आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फरमाया, बकरी तेरे काम में आएगी या तेरे भाई के, नहीं तोह भेड़िया खा जाएगा। फिर उस शख्स ने कहा, अगर ऊंट भूला मिले? आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फरमाया, ऊंट से तुझे क्या काम? वोह तोह अपने साथ अपना पानी रखता है और मौज़े (पैर) रखता है, जहां उसको पानी मिल जाता है पी लेता है, जो दरख्त मिलता है खा लेता है यहां तक के मालिक उसका उसको पा लेता है।

language_versions.text: Zaid bin Khalid Juhani (Radi Allahu Anhu) se riwayat hai ke ek shakhs aaya Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aur pucha Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se luqta (giri hui cheez) ke bare mein. Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, pehchan rakh taraf uske luqte ki, khwah chamde mein ho ya kapde mein, aur pehchan rakh bandhan uska, phir ek baras tak logon se uska haal kaha kar, agar uska malik mil jaye toh uske de de, nahi toh le le. Phir usne kaha, agar koi bakri behki bhatki mil jaye ya Rasool Allah? Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, bakri tere kaam mein aayegi ya tere bhai ke, nahi toh bhediya kha jayega. Phir us shakhs ne kaha, agar oonth bhoola mile? Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, oonth se tujhe kya kaam? Woh toh apne saath apna pani rakhta hai aur mouze (pair) rakhta hai, jahan usko pani mil jata hai pi leta hai, jo darakht milta hai kha leta hai yahan tak ke malik uska usko pa leta hai.

title: Chapter 36
text_arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أُمِّي افْتُلِتَتْ نَفْسُهَا وَأُرَاهَا لَوْ تَكَلَّمَتْ تَصَدَّقَتْ أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

title: Chapter 36
text_arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ مِنْ بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ تَصَدَّقَ عَلَى أَبَوَيْهِ بِصَدَقَةٍ فَهَلَكَا فَوَرِثَ ابْنُهُمَا الْمَالَ وَهُوَ نَخْلٌ فَسَأَلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ قَدْ أُجِرْتَ فِي صَدَقَتِكَ وَخُذْهَا بِمِيرَاثِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
text_translation: हज़रत आइशा (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हा) से रिवायत है के एक शख़्स ने रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) से कहा के मेरी माँ का दम यकायक निकल गया, अगर बात करने पाती तो ज़रूर सदक़ा करती, क्या मैं उसकी तरफ़ से सदक़ा करूँ? आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया हाँ। एक अंसारी शख़्स ने अपने वालिदैन को खजूर के दरख़्त सदक़ा में दिए, फिर वालिदैन मर गए तो वही शख़्स उसका वारिस हुआ। उसने रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) से बयान किया, आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया तुझे सदक़े का सवाब हुआ, अब मीरास में इसको ले ले।

title: Chapter 37
text_arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا حَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ لَهُ شَىْءٌ يُوصَى فِيهِ يَبِيتُ لَيْلَتَيْنِ إِلاَّ وَوَصِيَّتُهُ عِنْدَهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
text_translation: अब्दुल्लाह बिन उम्र (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) से रिवायत है के रसूल अल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया है आदमी को जिसके पास चीज़ या मामला ऐसा हो जिसमें वसीयत करना ज़रूरी हो और वो दो रातें गुज़ारे बग़ैर वसीयत लिखे हुए. मलिक ने कहा अगर मौसी अपनी वसीयत के बदलने पर क़ादिर न होता तो चाहिए था के हर वसीयत करने वाले का माल उसके इख़्तियार से निकल कर रुका रहता तदबीर के. मलिक ने कहा हमारे नज़दीक हर वसीयत को बदल सकता है सिवाए तद्बीर के.

language_versions.text: Abdullah bin Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, nahi layak hai aadmi ko jiske paas cheez ya mamla aisa ho jisme wasiyat karna zaroori ho aur wo do raatein guzare baghair wasiyat likhe huye. Malik ne kaha agar mosi apni wasiyat ke badalne par qadir na hota to chahiye tha ke har wasiyat karne wale ka maal uske ikhtiyar se nikal kar ruka rehta, halanki aisa nahi hai, kabhi aadmi apni sehat ko badal sakta hai siwaye tadbeer ke. Malik ne kaha hamare nazdeek har wasiyat ko badal sakta hai siwaye tadbeer ke.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me from Nafi from Abdullah ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, "It is the duty of a muslim man who has something to be given as a bequest not to spend two nights without writing a will about it." Malik said, "The generally agreed-on way of doing things in our community is that when the testator writes something in health or illness as a bequest, and it has freeing slaves or things other than that in it, he can alter it in any way he chooses, until he is on his deathbed. If he prefers to abandon a bequest or change it, he can do so unless he has made a slave mudabbar (to be freed after his death). If he has made him mudabbar, there is no way to change what he has made mudabbar. He is allowed to change his testament because the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, "It is the duty of a muslim man who has something to be given as a bequest not to spend two nights without writing a will about it." Malik explained, "Had the testator not been able to change his will nor what was mentioned in it about freeing slaves, each testator might withhold making bequests from his property, whether in freeing slaves or other than it. A man gives a bequest in his health and in his travelling." (i.e. he does not wait till his death bed ) . Malik summed up, "The way of doing things in our community about which there is no dispute is that he can change whatever he likes of that except for the mudabbar

Umar ibn al-Khattab instructed, "Let him leave her a bequest." He willed her a property called the well of Jusham.

comments.text: अम्र बिन सालिम ज़ुरक़ी से रिवायत है के हज़रत उमर बिन ख़त्ताब (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) से कहा गया के इस जगह मदीना में एक लड़का है क़रीब-ए-बुलूग़ के मगर बालिग़ नहीं हुआ, क़बीला ग़स्सान से और उसके वारिस शाम में हैं और उसके पास माल है और यहाँ उसका कोई वारिस नहीं सिवाए एक चाचा ज़ाद बहन के। तो हज़रत उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने कहा उसको वसीयत करे। उस लड़के ने माल की वसीयत जिसका नाम बीर जशम था अपनी चाचा ज़ाद बहन के वास्ते की। अम्र बिन सालिम ने कहा वो माल तीस हज़ार दिरहम का बिका और उसकी चाचा ज़ाद बहन अम्र बिन सालिम की माँ थी। अबू बक्र बिन हज़्म से रिवायत है के एक लड़का ग़स्सान का मरने लगा मदीना में और वारिस उसके शाम में थे, हज़रत उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) से उसका ज़िक्र हुआ और पूछा गया क्या वसीयत करे? आप ने फ़रमाया वसीयत करे। यहया बिन सईद ने कहा वो लड़का दस बरस का था या बारह बरस का और बीर जशम छोड़ गया, उसकी वसीयत कर गया, लोगों ने उसे तीस हज़ार दिरहम का बेचा। मालिक ने कहा हमारे नज़दीक ये हुक्म इत्तेफ़ाक़ी है के ज़ईफ़-उल-अक़्ल और नादान और मजनून की जिसको कभी अफ़ाक़ा हो जाता है वसीयत दुरुस्त है, जब इतनी अक़्ल रखते हों के वसीयत जो करें उसको समझें, अगर इतनी भी अक़्ल न हो तो उसकी वसीयत दुरुस्त नहीं है।

comments.text: Amr bin Salim Zurqi se riwayat hai ke Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Radi Allahu Anhu) se kaha gaya ke is jagah Madina mein ek ladka hai qareeb-e-bulugh ke magar baligh nahi hua, qabeela Ghassan se aur uske waris Shaam mein hain aur uske paas maal hai aur yahan uska koi waris nahi siwaye ek chacha zad behen ke. To Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha usko wasiyat kare. Us ladke ne maal ki wasiyat jiska naam Bir Jashm tha apni chacha zad behen ke waste ki. Amr bin Salim ne kaha wo maal tees hazaar dirham ka bika aur uski chacha zad behen Amr bin Salim ki maa thi. Abu Bakr bin Hazm se riwayat hai ke ek ladka Ghassan ka marne laga Madina mein aur waris uske Shaam mein the, Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) se uska zikr hua aur pucha gaya kya wasiyat kare? Aap ne farmaya wasiyat kare. Yahya bin Saeed ne kaha wo ladka das baras ka tha ya barah baras ka aur Bir Jashm chhod gaya, uski wasiyat kar gaya, logon ne use tees hazaar dirham ka becha. Malik ne kaha hamare nazdeek ye hukm ittefaqi hai ke zaeef-ul-aql aur nadan aur majnoon ki jisko kabhi afaqa ho jata hai wasiyat durust hai, jab itni aql rakhte hon ke wasiyat jo karein usko samjhein, agar itni bhi aql na ho to uski wasiyat durust nahi hai.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me from Yahya ibn Said from Abu Bakr ibn Hazm that a boy from Ghassan was dying in Madina while his heir was in Syria. That was mentioned to Umar ibn al-Khattab. It was said to him, "So-and-so is dying. Shall he make a bequest?" He said, "Let him make a bequest." Yahya ibn Said said that Abu Bakr had said, "He was a boy of ten or twelve years." Yahya said, "He willed the well of Jusham, and his people sold it for 30,000 dirhams."

title: Chapter 37
text_arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ مِنْ وَجَعٍ اشْتَدَّ بِي فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ بَلَغَ بِي مِنَ الْوَجَعِ مَا تَرَى وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ وَلاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ ابْنَةٌ لِي أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ فَالشَّطْرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ إِنَّكَ أَنْ تَذَرَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ وَإِنَّكَ لَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أُجِرْتَ حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَأُخَلَّفُ بَعْدَ أَصْحَابِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُخَلَّفَ فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحًا إِلاَّ ازْدَدْتَ بِهِ دَرَجَةً وَرِفْعَةً وَلَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تُخَلَّفَ حَتَّى يَنْتَفِعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمْضِ لأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ وَلاَ تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ لَكِنِ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ ابْنُ خَوْلَةَ يَرْثِي لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ مَاتَ بِمَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
text_translation: इमाम मालिक ने इब्न शिहाब से, उन्होंने आमिर बिन सअद बिन अबी वक़्क़ास से, उन्होंने अपने वालिद से रिवायत किया के रसूलअल्लाह (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) हज्जतुल विदा के साल मेरी ऐसी बीमारी की अयादत के लिए तशरीफ़ लाए जो ना-क़ाबिल-ए-बरदाश्त हो गई थी। मैं ने अर्ज़ किया: ऐ अल्लाह के रसूल! आप देख रहे हैं के बीमारी मुझे कहाँ तक ले आई है, मेरे पास माल है और मेरी सिर्फ़ एक बेटी वारिस है, क्या मैं अपने दो-तिहाई माल का सदक़ा कर दूँ? आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया: 'नहीं।' मैं ने अर्ज़ किया: 'आधा?' फ़रमाया: 'नहीं।' फिर आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया: 'एक तिहाई, और एक तिहाई बहुत ज़्यादा है, अपने वुरसा को मालदार छोड़ना इस से बेहतर है के उन्हें मोहताज छोड़ो के वो लोगों के सामने हाथ फैलाएं। तुम अल्लाह की रज़ा की ख़ातिर जो भी ख़र्च करोगे उस पर तुम्हें अजर मिलेगा, यहाँ तक के वो लुक़मा भी जो तुम अपनी बीवी के मुँह में डालते हो।' सअद ने कहा: 'ऐ अल्लाह के रसूल! क्या मैं अपने साथियों के मदीना जाने के बाद यहीं मक्का में पीछे रह जाऊँगा?' आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया: 'अगर तुम पीछे रह गए और तुम ने नेक आमाल किए तो तुम्हारे दरजात और बुलंदी में इज़ाफ़ा होगा। शायद तुम इस लिए पीछे रह जाओ के कुछ लोग तुम से फ़ायदा उठाएं और दूसरे नुक़सान उठाएं। ऐ अल्लाह! मेरे साथियों की हिजरत को मुकम्मल फ़र्मा और उन्हें उल्टे पाँव वापस न मोड़।' सअद बिन ख़वला के बारे में आप (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ग़मज़दा थे क्योंकि उनका इंतक़ाल मक्का में हुआ था।

language_versions.text: امام مالک نے ابن شہاب سے، انہوں نے عامر بن سعد بن ابی وقاص سے، انہوں نے اپنے والد سے روایت کیا کہ رسول اللہ (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) حجۃ الوداع کے سال میری ایسی بیماری کی عیادت کے لیے تشریف لائے جو ناقابل برداشت ہو گئی تھی۔ میں نے عرض کیا: اے اللہ کے رسول! آپ دیکھ رہے ہیں کہ بیماری مجھے کہاں تک لے آئی ہے، میرے پاس مال ہے اور میری صرف ایک بیٹی وارث ہے، کیا میں اپنے دو تہائی مال کا صدقہ کر دوں؟ آپ (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) نے فرمایا: 'نہیں۔' میں نے عرض کیا: 'آدھا؟' فرمایا: 'نہیں۔' پھر آپ (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) نے فرمایا: 'ایک تہائی، اور ایک تہائی بہت زیادہ ہے، اپنے ورثاء کو مالدار چھوڑنا اس سے بہتر ہے کہ انہیں محتاج چھوڑو کہ وہ لوگوں کے سامنے ہاتھ پھیلائیں۔ تم اللہ کی رضا کی خاطر جو بھی خرچ کرو گے اس پر تمہیں اجر ملے گا، یہاں تک کہ وہ لقمہ بھی جو تم اپنی بیوی کے منہ میں ڈالتے ہو۔' سعد نے کہا: 'اے اللہ کے رسول! کیا میں اپنے ساتھیوں کے مدینہ جانے کے بعد یہیں مکہ میں پیچھے رہ جاؤں گا؟' آپ (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) نے فرمایا: 'اگر تم پیچھے رہ گئے اور تم نے نیک اعمال کیے تو تمہارے درجات اور بلندی میں اضافہ ہوگا۔ شاید تم اس لیے پیچھے رہ جاؤ کہ کچھ لوگ تم سے فائدہ اٹھائیں اور دوسرے نقصان اٹھائیں۔ اے اللہ! میرے ساتھیوں کی ہجرت کو مکمل فرما اور انہیں الٹے پاؤں واپس نہ موڑ۔' سعد بن خولہ کے بارے میں آپ (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) غمزدہ تھے کیونکہ ان کا انتقال مکہ میں ہوا تھا۔

language_versions.text: Imam Malik ne Ibn Shihab se, unhon ne Amir bin Sad bin Abi Waqqas se, unhon ne apne walid se riwayat kiya ke RasoolAllah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hajjatul Wida ke saal meri aisi bimari ki ayadat ke liye tashreef laye jo na-qabil-e-bardasht ho gayi thi. Main ne arz kiya: Aye Allah ke Rasool! Aap dekh rahe hain ke bimari mujhe kahan tak le aayi hai, mere paas maal hai aur meri sirf ek beti waris hai, kya main apne do-tihai maal ka sadaqa kar doon? Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: 'Nahi.' Main ne arz kiya: 'Aadha?' Farmaya: 'Nahi.' Phir aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: 'Ek tihai, aur ek tihai bahut zyada hai, apne wursa ko maldar chhorna is se behtar hai ke unhein mohtaj chhoro ke woh logon ke samne hath phelaayein. Tum Allah ki raza ki khatir jo bhi kharch karoge us par tumhein ajar milega, yahan tak ke woh luqma bhi jo tum apni biwi ke munh mein dalte ho.' Sad ne kaha: 'Aye Allah ke Rasool! Kya main apne sathiyon ke Madina jaane ke baad yaheen Makka mein peeche reh jaunga?' Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: 'Agar tum peeche reh gaye aur tum ne nek aamal kiye to tumhare darjaat aur bulandi mein izafa hoga. Shayad tum is liye peeche reh jao ke kuch log tum se fayda uthayein aur dusre nuqsan uthayein. Aye Allah! mere sathiyon ki hijrat ko mukammal farma aur unhein ulte paon wapas na mor.' Sad bin Khawla ke bare mein aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghamzada the kyunke unka inteqal Makka mein hua tha.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me from Ibn Shihab from Amir ibn Sad ibn Abi Waqqas that his father said, "The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came to me to treat me for a pain which became hard to bear in the year of the farewell hajj. I said, 'Messenger of Allah, you can see how far the pain has reached me. I have property and only my daughter inherits from me. Shall I give two thirds of my property as sadaqa?' The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, 'No.' I said, 'Half?' He said, 'No.' Then the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, 'A third, and a third is a lot. Leaving your heirs rich is better than leaving them poor to beg from people. You never spend anything on maintenance desiring the Face of Allah by it, but that you are rewarded for it, even what you appoint for your wife.' Sad said, 'Messenger of Allah, will I be left here in Makka after my companions have departed for Madina?' The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, 'If you are left behind, and do sound deeds you will increase your degree and elevation by them. Perhaps you will be left behind so that some people may benefit by you and others may be harmed by you. O Allah! complete their hijra for my companions, and do not turn them back on their heels. The unfortunate one is Said ibn Khawla.' The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was distressed on his account for he had died at Makka." Yahya said that he heard Malik speak about a man who willed a third of his property to a man and said as well, "My slave will serve so-and-so (another man) for as long as he lives, then he is free," then that was looked into, and the slave was found to be a third of the property of the deceased. Malik said, "The service of the slave is evaluated. Then the two of them divide it between them. The one who was willed a third takes his third, as a share, and the one who was willed the service of the slave takes what was evaluated for him of the slave's service. Each of them takes, from the service of the slave or from his wage if he has a wage, according to his share. If the one who was given the service of the slave for as long as he lived dies, then the slave is freed." arabic.text: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ مِنْ وَجَعٍ اشْتَدَّ بِي فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ بَلَغَ بِي مِنَ الْوَجَعِ مَا تَرَى وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ وَلاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ ابْنَةٌ لِي أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ فَالشَّطْرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ إِنَّكَ أَنْ تَذَرَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ وَإِنَّكَ لَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أُجِرْتَ حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَأُخَلَّفُ بَعْدَ أَصْحَابِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُخَلَّفَ فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحًا إِلاَّ ازْدَدْتَ بِهِ دَرَجَةً وَرِفْعَةً وَلَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تُخَلَّفَ حَتَّى يَنْتَفِعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمْضِ لأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ وَلاَ تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ لَكِنِ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ ابْنُ خَوْلَةَ يَرْثِي لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ مَاتَ بِمَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

title: Chapter 37
text_arabic: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ مُخَنَّثًا، كَانَ عِنْدَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْمَعُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ إِنْ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ الطَّائِفَ غَدًا فَأَنَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى ابْنَةِ غَيْلاَنَ فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبِلُ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَتُدْبِرُ بِثَمَانٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلَنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
text_translation: यहया ने इमाम मालिक से रिवायत किया के हामिला औरत की वसीयत के बारे में बेहतरीन बात यह है के हामिला औरत बीमार की तरह है। जब बीमारी हल्की हो और मरीज़ के लिए कोई ख़ौफ़ न हो तो वो अपने माल में जो चाहे कर सकता है। अगर बीमारी ऐसी हो के उसकी ज़िंदगी का ख़तरा हो तो वो सिर्फ़ एक तिहाई जायदाद में तसर्रुफ़ कर सकता है। हमल की इब्तिदा ख़ुशख़बरी है, इस में कोई बीमारी या ख़ौफ़ नहीं। जैसा के अल्लाह तआला ने फ़रमाया: 'हम ने उसे इसहाक़ और याक़ूब की ख़ुशख़बरी दी।' जब हामिला औरत का हमल भारी हो जाए तो उसे सिर्फ़ एक तिहाई जायदाद में तसर्रुफ़ की इजाज़त है। यह पाबंदी हमल के छह माह बाद शुरू होती है क्योंकि अल्लाह ने फ़रमाया: 'उसका हमल और दूध छुड़ाना तीस महीने है।' जब छह माह गुज़र जाएं तो उसे सिर्फ़ एक तिहाई माल में वसीयत की इजाज़त है। हिशाम बिन उरवा से रिवायत है के एक मुख़न्नस शख़्स उम्म सलमा (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हा) के पास था, उस ने अब्दुल्लाह बिन अबी उमय्या से कहा जबके नबी करीम (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) सुन रहे थे: 'अब्दुल्लाह! अगर कल अल्लाह ने तुम्हें ताइफ़ पर फ़तह दी तो मैं तुम्हें ग़ैलान की बेटी के पास ले चलूँगा, उस के पेट पर चार और कमर पर आठ बल हैं।' नबी करीम (सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम) ने फ़रमाया: 'ऐसे लोगों को तुम्हारे पास बिला झिझक नहीं आना चाहिए।'

language_versions.text: یحییٰ نے امام مالک سے روایت کیا کہ حاملہ عورت کی وصیت کے بارے میں بہترین بات یہ ہے کہ حاملہ عورت بیمار کی طرح ہے۔ جب بیماری ہلکی ہو اور مریض کے لیے کوئی خوف نہ ہو تو وہ اپنے مال میں جو چاہے کر سکتا ہے۔ اگر بیماری ایسی ہو کہ اس کی زندگی کا خطرہ ہو تو وہ صرف ایک تہائی جائیداد میں تصرف کر سکتا ہے۔ حمل کی ابتدا خوشخبری ہے، اس میں کوئی بیماری یا خوف نہیں۔ جیسا کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے فرمایا: 'ہم نے اسے اسحاق اور یعقوب کی خوشخبری دی۔' جب حاملہ عورت کا حمل بھاری ہو جائے تو اسے صرف ایک تہائی جائیداد میں تصرف کی اجازت ہے۔ یہ پابندی حمل کے چھ ماہ بعد شروع ہوتی ہے کیونکہ اللہ نے فرمایا: 'اس کا حمل اور دودھ چھڑانا تیس مہینے ہے۔' جب چھ ماہ گزر جائیں تو اسے صرف ایک تہائی مال میں وصیت کی اجازت ہے۔ ہشام بن عروہ سے روایت ہے کہ ایک مخنث شخص ام سلمہ (رضی اللہ عنہا) کے پاس تھا، اس نے عبداللہ بن ابی امیہ سے کہا جبکہ نبی کریم (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) سن رہے تھے: 'عبداللہ! اگر کل اللہ نے تمہیں طائف پر فتح دی تو میں تمہیں غیلان کی بیٹی کے پاس لے چلوں گا، اس کے پیٹ پر چار اور کمر پر آٹھ بل ہیں۔' نبی کریم (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) نے فرمایا: 'ایسے لوگوں کو تمہارے پاس بلا جھجک نہیں آنا چاہیے۔'

language_versions.text: Yahya ne Imam Malik se riwayat kiya ke hamila aurat ki wasiyat ke bare mein behtareen baat yeh hai ke hamila aurat bimar ki tarah hai. Jab bimari halki ho aur mareez ke liye koi khauf na ho to woh apne maal mein jo chahe kar sakta hai. Agar bimari aisi ho ke uski zindagi ka khatra ho to woh sirf ek tihai jaidad mein tasarruf kar sakta hai. Hamal ki ibtida khushkhabri hai, is mein koi bimari ya khauf nahi. Jaisa ke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Hum ne use Ishaq aur Yaqub ki khushkhabri di.' Jab hamila aurat ka hamal bhari ho jaye to use sirf ek tihai jaidad mein tasarruf ki ijazat hai. Yeh pabandi hamal ke chhay mah baad shuru hoti hai kyunke Allah ne farmaya: 'Uska hamal aur doodh chhudana tees mahine hai.' Jab chhay mah guzar jayein to use sirf ek tihai maal mein wasiyat ki ijazat hai. Hisham bin Urwa se riwayat hai ke ek mukhannas shakhs Umm Salama (Razi Allahu Anha) ke paas tha, us ne Abdullah bin Abi Umayya se kaha jabke Nabi Kareem (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sun rahe the: 'Abdullah! Agar kal Allah ne tumhein Ta'if par fatah di to main tumhein Ghailan ki beti ke paas le chalunga, us ke pet par char aur kamar par aath bal hain.' Nabi Kareem (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: 'Aise logon ko tumhare paas bila jhijhak nahi aana chahiye.'

language_versions.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "The best of what I have heard about the testament of a pregnant woman and about what settlements she is permitted in her property is that the pregnant woman is like the sick person. When the illness is light, and one does not fear for the sick person, he does with his property what he likes. If the illness is such that his life is feared for, he can only dispose of a third of his estate." He said, "It is the same with a woman who is pregnant. The beginning of pregnancy is good news and joy. It is not illness and no fear because Allah the Blessed, the Exalted, said in His Book, 'We gave her good news of Ishaq and after Ishaq, Yaqub.' (Sura ll ayat 71). And He said, 'She bore a light burden and passed by with it, but when she became heavy, they called upon Allah, their Lord, "If you give us a good-doing son, we will be among the thankful." '(Sura 7 ayat 189). "When a pregnant woman becomes heavy, she is only permitted to dispose of a third of her estate. The beginning of this restriction is after six months. Allah, the Blessed, the Exalted, said in His Book, 'Mothers suckle their children for two complete years.' And He said, 'his bearing and weaning are thirty months.' (Sura 2 ayat 233). "When six months have passed for the pregnant woman from the day she conceived, she is only permitted to dispose of a third of her property." Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "A man who is advancing in the row for battle, can only dispose of a third of his property. He is in the same position as a pregnant woman or an ill person who is feared for, as long as he is in that situation." Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "This ayat is abrogated. It is the word of Allah, the Blessed, the Exalted, 'If he leaves goods, the testament is for parents and kinsmen.' What came down about the division of the fixed shares of inheritance in the Book of Allah, the Mighty, the Exalted, abrogated it." Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "The established sunna with us, in which there is no dispute, is that it is not permitted for a testator to make a bequest (in addition to the fixed share) in favour of an heir, unless the other heirs permit him. If some of them permit him and others refuse, he is allowed to diminish the share of those who have given their permission. Those who refuse take their full share from the inheritance. Yahya said that he heard Malik speak about an invalid who made a bequest and asked his heirs to give him permission to make a bequest when he was so ill that he only had command of a third of his property, and they gave him permission to leave some of his heirs more than his third. Malik said, "They cannot revoke that. Had they been permitted to do so, every heir would have done that, and then, when the testator died, they would take that for themselves and prevent him from bequeathing his third and what was permitted to him with respect to his property." Malik said, "If he asks permission of his heirs to grant a bequest to an heir while he is well and they give him permission, that is not binding on them. The heirs can rescind that if they wish. That is because when a man is well, he is entitled to all his property and can do what he wishes with it. If he wishes, he can spend all of it. He can spend it and give sadaqa with it or give it to whomever he likes. His asking permission of his heirs is permitted for the heirs, when they give him permission when authority over all his property is closed off from him and nothing outside of the third is permitted to him, and when they are more entitled to the two-thirds of his property than he is himself. That is when their permission becomes relevant. If he asks one of the heirs to give his inheritance to him when he is dying, and the heir agrees and then the dying man does not dispose of it at all, it is returned to the one who gave it unless the deceased said to him, 'So-and-so - (one of his heirs) - is weak, and I would like you to give him your inheritance.' So he gives it to him. That is permitted when the deceased specified it for him." Malik said, "When a man gives the dying man free use of his share of the inheritance, and the dying man distributes some of it and some remains, it is returned to the giver, after the man has died." Yahya said that he heard Malik speak about someone who made a bequest and mentioned that he had given one of his heirs something which he had not taken possession of, so the heirs refused to permit that. Malik said, "That gift returns to the heirs as inheritance according to the Book of Allah because the deceased did not mean that to be taken out of the third and the heirs do not have a portion in the third (which the dying man is allowed to bequeath)." Malik said from Hisham ibn Urwa from his father that an effeminate man was with Umm Salama, the wife of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. He said to Abdullah ibn Abi Umayya while the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was listening. "Abdullah! If Allah grants you victory over Ta'if tomorrow, I will lead you to the daughter of Ghailan. She has four folds on her front and eight folds on her back." The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said, "This sort of man should not enter freely with you." (It was customary to allow men with no sexual inclination to enter freely where there were women)

arabic.text: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ مُخَنَّثًا، كَانَ عِنْدَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْمَعُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ إِنْ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ الطَّائِفَ غَدًا فَأَنَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى ابْنَةِ غَيْلاَنَ فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبِلُ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَتُدْبِرُ بِثَمَانٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلَنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

comments.text: यह्या बिन सईद से रिवायत है के मैं ने कासिम बिन मुहम्मद से सुना, कहते थे हज़रत उमर बिन खत्ताब (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) के पास एक अंसारी औरत थी, उस से एक लड़का पैदा हुआ जिसका नाम आसिम बिन उमर रखा था। फिर हज़रत उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने उस औरत को छोड़ दिया और मस्जिद कुबा में आये, वहां आसिम को लड़कों के साथ खेलता हुआ पाया मस्जिद के सहन में। हज़रत उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने उसका बाज़ू पकड़ कर अपने जानवर पर सवार कर लिया। लड़के की नानी ने ये देख कर उनसे झगड़ा किया और अपना लड़का तलब किया। फिर दोनों हज़रत अबू बक्र सिद्दीक (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) के पास आये। हज़रत उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने कहा मेरा बेटा है, औरत ने कहा मेरा बच्चा है। अबू बक्र सिद्दीक (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) ने कहा उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) इसे छोड़ दो, बच्चे को और देदे उसकी नानी को। हज़रत उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) चुप हो रहे और कुछ तकरार न की।

comments.text: Yahya bin Saeed se riwayat hai ke main ne Qasim bin Muhammad se suna, kehte the Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Radi Allahu Anhu) ke paas ek Ansari aurat thi, us se ek ladka paida hua jiska naam Asim bin Umar rakha tha. Phir Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne us aurat ko chhod diya aur Masjid Quba mein aaye, wahan Asim ko ladkon ke saath khelta hua paya masjid ke sehan mein. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne uska bazu pakad kar apne janwar par sawar kar liya. Ladke ki naani ne ye dekh kar unse jhagda kiya aur apna ladka talab kiya. Phir dono Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Radi Allahu Anhu) ke paas aaye. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha mera beta hai, aurat ne kaha mera bachcha hai. Abu Bakr Siddiq (Radi Allahu Anhu) ne kaha Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ise chhod do, bachche ko aur dede uski naani ko. Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) chup ho rahe aur kuch takrar na ki.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me that Yahya ibn Said said that he heard al- Qasim ibn Muhammad say, "A woman of the Ansar was married to Umar ibn al-Khattab. She bore Asim ibn Umar to him, and then he separated from her. Umar came to Quba and found his son Asim playing in the courtyard of the mosque. He took him by the arm and placed him before him on his mount. The grandmother of the child saw him and argued with Umar about the child so they went to Abu Bakr as-Siddiq. Umar said, 'My son.' The woman said, 'My son.' Abu Bakr said, 'Do not interfere between a child and its mother.' Umar did not repeat his words."

comments.text: इमाम मालिक ने यह्या बिन सईद से रिवायत किया के अबू-द-दरदा ने सलमान अल-फारसी को लिखा, 'फौरन मुकद्दस सरज़मीन की तरफ आ जाओ।' सलमान ने जवाब दिया, 'ज़मीन किसी को मुकद्दस नहीं बनाती, आदमी के आमाल उसे मुकद्दस बनाते हैं। मुझे मालूम हुआ है के आप लोगों के इलाज के लिए डॉक्टर बने बैठे हैं। अगर आप मुखलिस हैं तो खुश हो जायें, और अगर आप नीम-हकीम हैं तो डरें के कहीं किसी को मार कर आग में न दाखिल हो जायें।' यह्या ने इमाम मालिक से नक़ल किया के अगर कोई किसी के गुलाम को मालिक की इजाज़त के बगै़र इस्तेमाल करे, तो वह उस के नुक्सान का ज़िम्मेदार है। अगर गुलाम महफूज़ रहे और मालिक उसकी मज़दूरी मांगे तो यह मालिक का हक है।

comments.text: Imam Malik ne Yahya bin Saeed se riwayat kiya ke Abu'd-Darda ne Salman al-Farsi ko likha, 'Foran muqaddas sarzameen ki taraf aa jao.' Salman ne jawab diya, 'Zameen kisi ko muqaddas nahi banati, aadmi ke aamal use muqaddas banate hain. Mujhe maloom hua hai ke aap logon ke ilaj ke liye doctor bane baithe hain. Agar aap mukhlis hain to khush ho jayein, aur agar aap neem-hakeem hain to darein ke kahin kisi ko maar kar aag mein na dakhil ho jayein.' Yahya ne Imam Malik se naqal kiya ke agar koi kisi ke ghulam ko malik ki ijazat ke baghair istemal kare, to woh us ke nuqsan ka zimmedar hai. Agar ghulam mehfooz rahe aur malik uski mazdoori mange to yeh malik ka haq hai.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me from Yahya ibn Said that Abu'd-Darda wrote to Salman al-Farsi, "Come immediately to the holy land." Salman wrote back to him, "Land does not make anyone holy. Man's deeds make him holy. I have heard that you were put up as a doctor to treat and cure people. If you are innocent, then may you have delight! If you are a quack, then beware lest you kill a man and enter the Fire!" When Abu'd-Darda judged between two men, and they turned from him to go, he would look at them and say, "Come back to me, and tell me your story again. A quack! By Allah!"

comments.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik speak about a man who bought goods - animals or clothes or wares, and the sale was found not to be permitted so it was revoked and the one who had taken the goods was ordered to return the owner his goods. Malik said, "The owner of the goods only has their value on the day they were taken from him, and not on the day they are returned to him. That is because the man is liable for them from the day he took them and whatever loss is in them after that is against him. For that reason, their increase and growth are also his. A man may take the goods at a time when they are selling well and are in demand, and then have to return them at a time when they have fallen in price and no one wants them. For instance, the man may take the goods from the other man, and sell them for ten dinars or keep them while their price is that. Then he may have to return them while their price is only a dinar. He should not go off with nine dinars from the man's property. Or perhaps they are taken by the man, and he sells them for a dinar or keeps them, while their price is only a dinar, then he has to return them, and their value on the day he returns them is ten dinars. The one who took them does not have to pay nine dinars from his property to the owner. He is only obliged to pay the value of what he took possession of on the day it was taken ." He said, "Part of what clarifies this is that when a thief steals goods, only their price on the day he stole them is looked at. If cutting off the hand is necessary because of it, that is done. If the cutting off is delayed, either because the thief is imprisoned until his situation is examined or he flees and then is caught, the delay of the cutting off of the hand does not make the hadd, which was obliged for him on the day he stole, fall from him even if those goods become cheap after that. Nor does delay oblige cutting off the hand if it was not obliged on the day he took those goods, even if they become expensive after that."

comments.text: उमर बिन अब्दुल रहमान बिन दल्लाफ मुज़नी से रिवायत है के कबीला जुहैना का एक शख्स सब हाजियों से आगे जा कर अच्छे अच्छे महंगे ऊंट ख़रीदा करता था और जल्दी चला करता था, सब हाजियों से पहले पहुंचता था। एक बार वो मुफ़लिस हो गया और उस का मुक़दमा हज़रत उमर (रज़ियल्लाहु अन्हु) के पास आया। आप ने फ़रमाया: बाद हम्द-ओ-सलावत के, लोगों को मालूम हो के उसैफ़ा ने, जो जुहैना के कबीले का है, दीन और अमानत में बुरी बात पसंद की के लोग उस को कहा करें के वो सब हाजियों से पहले पहुंचा। आगाह रहो के इस ने क़र्ज़ ख़रीदा, अदा करने का ख्याल न रखा तो वो मुफ़लिस हो गया और क़र्ज़ ने उस के माल को लपेट लिया, तो जिस शख्स का उस पर क़र्ज़ आता है वो हमारे पास सुबह को आये, हम उस का माल क़र्ज़-ख्वाहों को तकसीम करेंगे। तुम लोगों को चाहिये के क़र्ज़ लेने से परहेज़ करो, क़र्ज़ में लेते ही रंज होता है और आखिर में लड़ाई होती है।

comments.text: Umar bin Abdul Rahman bin Dallaaf Muzni se riwayat hai ke qabeela Juhaina ka ek shakhs sab hajiyon se aage ja kar acche acche mehange oont khareeda karta tha aur jaldi chala karta tha, sab hajiyon se pehle pahunchta tha. Ek baar wo muflis ho gaya aur us ka muqadma Hazrat Umar (Radi Allahu Anhu) ke paas aaya. Aap ne farmaya: Baad hamd-o-salawat ke, logon ko maloom ho ke Usaifa ne, jo Juhaina ke qabeele ka hai, deen aur amanat mein buri baat pasand ki ke log us ko kaha karen ke wo sab hajiyon se pehle pahuncha. Aagah raho ke is ne qarz khareeda, ada karne ka khayal na rakha to wo muflis ho gaya aur qarz ne us ke maal ko lapet liya, to jis shakhs ka us par qarz aata hai wo hamare paas subah ko aaye, hum us ka maal qarz-khwahon ko taqseem karenge. Tum logon ko chahiye ke qarz lene se parhez karo, qarz mein lete hi ranj hota hai aur aakhir mein ladai hoti hai.

language_versions.text: Malik related to me from Umar ibn Abd ar-Rahman ibn Dalaf al- Muzani from his father that a man from the Juhayna tribe used to buy camels before people set out for hajj and sell them at a higher price. Then he travelled quickly and used to arrive in Makka before the others who set out for hajj. He went bankrupt and his situation was put before Umar ibn al-Khattab, who said, "O People! al-Usayfi, al- Usayfi of the Juhayna, was satisfied with his deen and his trust because it was said of him that he arrived before the others on hajj. He used to incur debts which he was not careful to repay, so all of his property has been eaten up by it. Whoever has a debt against him, let him come to us tomorrow and we will divide his property between his creditors. Beware of debts! Their beginning is a worry and their end is destitution

comments.text: Imam Malik ne kaha ke hamare han ghulamon ke jaraim ke bare mein sunnat yeh hai ke kisi ghulam ka hath nahi kata jayega agar woh kisi ko nuqsan pahunchaye ya chori kare. comments.text: Yahya said that he heard Malik say, "The sunna with us about the crime of slaves is that the hand is not cut off for any harm that a slave causes a man, or something he pilfers, or something guarded which he steals, or hanging dates he cuts down or ruins, or steals. That is against the slave's person and does not exceed the price of the slave whether it is little or much. If his master wishes to give the value of what the slave took or ruined, or pay the blood-price for the injury, he pays it and keeps his slave. If he wishes to surrender him, he surrenders him, and none of that is against him. The master has the option in that."
